A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same circuit-analysis and back-patching research. Their complete main texts and appendices, including equations, tables and figures, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original circuit-discovery, interchange, alignment and back-patching experiments across five tasks and three VLMs, plus VQAv2 results and appendix controls.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains original empirical results and additionally reports RealWorldQA evaluation and PaliGemma2 experiments at three model sizes.

M1.justification: Circuit discovery, sub-circuit partitioning and interchange, alignment measurement, and back-patching retain the same procedures. Expanded mapping explanations and experiments on additional models do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Appendix E.4 adds RealWorldQA alongside the retained VQAv2 evaluation. The five constructed tasks remain unchanged; the PaliGemma2 experiments reuse those tasks rather than expand task coverage.

E2.justification: The comparisons retain unmodified-model baselines, textual back-patching controls and random-circuit baselines. PaliGemma2 supplies additional models receiving the same baseline-versus-intervention evaluation, rather than a new competing method.

E3.justification: New experiments evaluate PaliGemma2 at 3B, 10B and 28B parameters and all 765 RealWorldQA prompts. Existing discovery splits, back-patching layer settings and the 3,000-prompt VQAv2 sample are retained. The immediate-answer VQA procedure is newly documented, without establishing a change to the earlier experiment.

E4.justification: Appendix E.5 adds a sensitivity analysis asking how back-patching benefits vary across model sizes. Figure 14 also replaces the Pixtral and Gemma sentiment heatmaps that duplicated arithmetic panels in v1. The iterative back-patching and textual-control analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v1 reports back-patching point estimates without uncertainty analysis. v3 introduces 1,000-iteration bootstrap resampling, standard deviations and a lower-bound-versus-baseline significance check, with significance highlighting in Table 1 and uncertainty for general-VQA and model-scale results. These are resampling estimates, not evidence of additional independent training runs.

E6.justification: Tables 8–10 add RealWorldQA and PaliGemma2 results, substantially extending the reported evidence. Existing Table 1 gains also change: Qwen factual recall rises from 0.3 to 1.6 percentage points, while Pixtral arithmetic changes from 7.6 to 6.7. Table 4 revises two Qwen baseline values, and Figure 14 replaces two heatmaps. The VQAv2 accuracies remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix A.2–A.3 expresses the existing circuit partition and positional mapping through explicit tuple and set notation. These restate the definitions and operations already described in Sections 2.1 and 4.1; the operative mathematics is unchanged, with no new theorem, proof or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims of structurally distinct modality circuits, interchangeable query/generation functionality, modality-specific data processing and training-free back-patching that closes roughly one-third of the performance gap. Additional experiments support these retained claims.

C2.justification: The revised limitations explicitly address image-before-query ordering, single-token analysis and uncertain applicability beyond adapter-based VLMs. Appendix E.5 adds an explanation for model-scale differences. The earlier suggestion that factual recall needs improved query-position processing is removed.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 newly states that positional mappings are manually specified per task/model, gives a concrete token-position example and identifies accompanying code as containing the mappings. Appendix E.4 documents immediate-answer evaluation. Existing code-access information, hardware details and discovery splits remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations for integrated gradients, PaliGemma2 and RealWorldQA, removes the Marr–Poggio framing, and drops an explicit methodological contrast with Wu et al. The substantive related-work discussion and overall research positioning remain largely unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording clarifications, expands the explanatory Appendix A, separates limitations from conclusions and reorders Appendix E. Most prose and the main narrative remain intact; this is not a wholesale rewrite.

P2.justification: Table 1 is transposed and expanded with absolute accuracies, uncertainty and significance colors. New Tables 8–10 display retained VQAv2 scores alongside new benchmark and scale results. Figures 1 and 6 receive graphical refinements, and Figure 14 replaces two panels. The overall visual organization is retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves empirical transparency through bootstrap uncertainty and broader back-patching checks, corrects duplicated sentiment-analysis panels, and clarifies mappings and applicability limits. These strengthen an already substantial experimental study. The gain remains limited because the core analysis is unchanged and the confidence level and construction of the significance bound remain unspecified.
